# Tailscale MCP — Full LLM Corpus

> Generated 2026-07-06. Source: https://github.com/sandraschi/tailscale-mcp

---

## Project Identity

Tailscale MCP is a FastMCP 3.2+ server that exposes the Tailscale Admin API as MCP tools
for AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Desktop, opencode). 24 portmanteau tools cover devices,
DNS, services, monitoring, Funnel, Taildrop, LM Link, and SEP-1577 agentic workflows.
An optional React/Vite webapp provides a dark glass-style dashboard on ports 10820/10821.

- **Python**: >=3.12, `uv` for package management
- **Framework**: FastMCP 3.4.2+ with portmanteau tool pattern
- **Webapp**: React/Vite frontend (port 10820) + FastAPI backend (port 10821)
- **Native**: Tauri 2.0 NSIS installer with embedded PyInstaller backend
- **License**: MIT

---

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/tailscale-mcp
cd tailscale-mcp
uv sync
uv run tailscale-mcp
```

Requires `TAILSCALE_API_KEY` and `TAILSCALE_TAILNET` environment variables.
Optional sampling variables: `TAILSCALE_SAMPLING_BASE_URL`, `TAILSCALE_SAMPLING_MODEL`.

---

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Frontend (Vite dev) | 10820 |
| Backend/MCP HTTP | 10821 |
| Prometheus metrics | 9091 |

---

## Architecture

```
src/tailscalemcp/
  tools/           # MCP tool surface (portmanteau pattern, 23 files)
  operations/      # Business logic layer
  client/          # Tailscale API client with rate limiting + retry
  models/          # Pydantic models
  server.py        # FastAPI backend for web_sota
  mcp_server.py    # FastMCP server setup
  transport.py     # Dual transport: stdio / HTTP / SSE
```

---

## MCP Tool Surface (24 tools)

All tools use the portmanteau pattern: one tool function per domain, with an `operation`
enum discriminator as the first parameter.

### Core domains

| Tool Name | Operations |
|-----------|------------|
| `manage_tailnet_devices` | device_list, device_get, device_update, device_delete, list_discovery_keys, list_auth_keys, approve_device, get_device_posture, etc. |
| `manage_tailnet_network` | dns_nameservers_list, dns_nameservers_set, dns_searchpaths, dns_preferences, magicdns_get, magicdns_set, dns_split, get_routes, set_routes, list_services, get_service |
| `monitor_tailnet` | metrics_list, metrics_get, prometheus_status, health_check, network_status |
| `manage_taildrop` | status, send, receive_list, receive_download, receive_delete |
| `manage_funnel` | funnel_enable, funnel_disable, funnel_status, funnel_list, funnel_certificate_info |
| `run_tailnet_security` | acl_get, acl_set, acl_validate, acl_preview, posture_list, posture_create, posture_update, posture_delete, device_keys_list, device_keys_revoke |
| `run_tailnet_automation` | webhook_list, webhook_create, webhook_delete, webhook_test, tag_list, tag_create, tag_delete, logging_config_get, logging_config_set |
| `manage_tailnet_backups` | backup_list, backup_create, backup_restore, backup_delete, backup_export, backup_import |
| `analyze_tailnet_performance` | analytics_get, analytics_trend, analytics_custom, report_usage, report_performance |
| `generate_tailnet_reports` | report_device_inventory, report_user_summary, report_security_audit, report_change_log |
| `manage_tailnet_integrations` | integration_list, integration_create, integration_update, integration_delete |

### New API domains

| Tool Name | Operations |
|-----------|------------|
| `manage_tailnet_invites` | invites_list, invite_create, invite_delete, invite_resend |
| `manage_posture_attributes` | posture_attributes_list, posture_attribute_create, posture_attribute_update, posture_attribute_delete |
| `manage_device_keys` | api_keys_list, api_key_create, api_key_delete |
| `manage_tailnet_logging` | logstream_list, logstream_create, logstream_update, logstream_delete |
| `manage_tailnet_webhooks` | webhook_list, webhook_create, webhook_update, webhook_delete, webhook_test |
| `manage_tailnet_settings` | settings_get, settings_update |
| `manage_tailnet_contacts` | contacts_list, contact_create, contact_update, contact_delete |

### Standalone utilities

| Tool Name | Operations |
|-----------|------------|
| `get_help` | overview, examples, best_practices, troubleshooting, funnel, sampling |
| `get_tailnet_status` | full, summary, health, devices, services |
| `summarize_partner_tailnets` | summary, users_list, user_get, devices_by_login |

### Agentic workflows

| Tool Name | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `run_agentic_tailnet_workflow` | SEP-1577 multi-step agentic workflows using ctx.sample() |

## LM Link — Tailscale + LM Studio (Feb 2026)

LM Link is a Tailscale-powered encrypted mesh for remote local LLM access.
The `get_lm_link` tool provides 7 operations for programmatic control via the `lms` CLI:

### Operations

| Operation | CLI equivalent | Description |
|-----------|---------------|-------------|
| `status` | `lms link status --json` | Live peers, loaded models, link state |
| `enable` | `lms link enable` | Enable LM Link on this device |
| `disable` | `lms link disable` | Disable LM Link |
| `set_device_name` | `lms link set-device-name <name>` | Rename this device |
| `set_preferred_device` | `lms link set-preferred-device <device>` | Route model requests to a preferred peer |
| `info` | (static) | Setup docs and links |
| `readiness` | (Tailscale API) | Tailnet connectivity check + lms binary detection |

### Implementation

- Uses `asyncio.create_subprocess_exec` with binary auto-discovery
- `_find_lms_binary()` searches `shutil.which("lms")` + known Windows paths
- `_run_lms()` wraps CLI calls with timeout, JSON parsing, structured error returns
- Graceful fallback when `lms` is not installed (returns `ok: false` with recovery instructions)

### Webapp page (`/lm-link`)

The `/lm-link` frontend page is a live dashboard showing:
- This device's name and link state (connected/inactive badge)
- Enable/disable toggle buttons
- Device name editor with inline rename
- Peers list with loaded model badges and preferred device indicators
- "Make preferred" button per peer
- Info/readiness cards behind a toggle

### Cross-repo

`local-llm-mcp` (port 10833) also probes `lms link status --json` for its provider health
dashboard and `llm_lmstudio(operation="link_status")` MCP tool.
